_comment: Editable rules mapping Huntington document titles to filename summaries. Huntington's own API already says WHICH KIND a record is (statement / taxDocument / correspondence) and the app files by that, so these rules only choose the wording inside the filename. Statement titles are a date range ('07/02/2026 - 08/03/2026') or 'MM/DD/YYYY Escrow Analysis'; tax titles read like '2025 1098 YEAR-END STATEMENT'; correspondence titles are 'MM/DD/YYYY Correspondence'. Repair these using the titles diagnose reports.
